The corona graph <jats:italic>G</jats:italic> ◦ <jats:italic>H </jats:italic>of <jats:italic>G</jats:italic> and <jats:italic>H</jats:italic> is the disjoint union of <jats:italic>G</jats:italic> and<jats:italic> H</jats:italic><jats:sub><jats:italic>v</jats:italic></jats:sub><jats:italic>, v </jats:italic>∈<jats:italic> V</jats:italic> (<jats:italic>G</jats:italic>), with additional edges joining each vertex <jats:italic>v</jats:italic> ∈ <jats:italic>V</jats:italic> (<jats:italic>G</jats:italic>) to all the vertices of <jats:italic>H</jats:italic><jats:sub><jats:italic>v</jats:italic></jats:sub>. In this paper, we are deeply concerned in investigating the (induced) matching number of the graph <jats:italic>G ◦ H</jats:italic>. It gives a formula for the Castelnuovo–Mumford regularity of edge ideal of this graph. Additionally, we propose a close relationship between independence polynomial of corona graph <jats:italic>G ◦ H</jats:italic> and h-polynomial of its independence simplicial complexes. Thereby, the formula of h-polynomial of <jats:italic>G◦H</jats:italic> is established and some properties of its unimodality and real-rootedness are presented.</jats:p>

items.abstract: The plucking polynomial is an invariant of rooted trees with connections to knot theory. The polynomial was constructed in 2014 as a tool to analyze lattice crossings after taking the quotient by the Kauffman bracket skein relations. In this paper we study the plucking polynomial and the plucking polynomial with delay function. We present a formula for the plucking polynomial of hedgehog rooted trees and explore the unimodality of this polynomial. In particular, we consider an anti-unimodal delay function and a delay function with a specific image set. Furthermore, we present a number of interesting examples and make some speculations on the unimodality of plucking polynomials with delay functions of hedgehog rooted trees.
title: Exploring unimodality of the plucking polynomial with delay function
